exclusions: Unrelated Point/smoke/error/quarantine caches, temporary files, credentials, .git history, frontend assets, crop datasets/rules, node_modules and Python bytecode.
manifest_self_hash: Excluded from files to avoid circular hashing; archive SHA-256 and external manifest SHA-256 are in the delivery receipt.

missingness.policy: Fill to null with reason; no interpolation, clipping or zero replacement; incomplete primary monthly values are null.

profiles.A: Original annual raw responses/manifests plus executable sources and required input/evidence files; offline raw reproduction.
profiles.B: Prepared regional/district views, monthly summaries, charts and replay inputs with provenance/terms; raw files need not be loaded for consumption.
profiles.optional_long_view: Canonical long-form observations retained to reproduce the original inventory; wide views suffice for combined daily consumption.

redistribution.NASA_notification: NASA POWER requests notification when data is transmitted to other researchers; none sent by this packaging task.
redistribution.status: Local teammate handoff only; not uploaded or publicly cleared
redistribution.unresolved: Public redistribution terms for the supplied BAMIS region mapping remain unverified; project-code license does not relicense third-party data.

PRECTOTCORR.definition: Average MERRA-2 bias-corrected total precipitation at the surface.
PRECTOTCORR.name: Precipitation Corrected

T2M_MAX.definition: Maximum hourly air temperature at 2 meters in the daily period.
T2M_MAX.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum

T2M_MIN.definition: Minimum hourly air temperature at 2 meters in the daily period.
T2M_MIN.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum

runtime.dependencies: Python standard library only; no pip install
runtime.exact_compression_note: Byte-for-byte compressed reproduction was tested in this runtime; other Python/zlib versions may encode equivalent data differently. Do not silently accept a byte mismatch.

scientific_limitations: Regional historical model/reanalysis context, not forecasts, station/field observations or district-area averages.
Original anchors remain interior; 11 mappings use output positions outside pinned simplified country polygons, not proof of surveyed border crossing.
Shared output observations are not independent district samples; distances and both coordinate roles remain explicit.
Unusual source values were preserved; checks establish reproducibility, not physical weather accuracy, agronomic approval or application integration.
Replay selection remains provisional; no engine replay, crop rule activation, yield or crop-failure inference.
